narr: Deep monsoon moisture and increasing shear produce severe thunderstorms and heavy rain over parts of northern Arizona.
ev: Torrential rain caused flash flooding of the pit mine near Bagdad. Some of the pit walls failed and collapsed. Workers were evacuated from the mine.
The river gauge on Granite Creek in Prescott measured about a 3 foot rise in about 90 minutes (from 7.40 at 300 PM to 10.35 feet at 430 PM).
Heavy rain caused flooding at Fir Street and Monte Tesoro Drive. The water covered the road one to two feet deep.
A flash flood was reported on Big Chino Wash by Yavapai Country Flood Control District. A river gauge on the wash showed a 4.64 foot rise.
lsr: FLASH FLOOD REPORTED ON BIG CHINO WASH BY YAVAPAI COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT. BCWA3 REPORTED A 4.64 FT RISE.
THE GRANITE CREEK (GCRA3) USGS RIVER GAUGE ROSE ROUGHLY 3 FEET IN AN HOUR AND A HALF FROM 7.40 FEET, CRESTING UP TO 10.35 FEET DUE TO HEAVY RAINFALL.
ROAD FLOODED AT FIR ST AND MONTE TESORO DRIVE. REPORT VIA FACEBOOK. WATER ESTIMATED TO BE 1-2 FEET DEEP.
